findings.text: non-blocking: the case_text quote check compares row["quote"] with row["case_quote"], two fields of the report being verified, so a quote altered together with its case_quote passes; the 8 rows classified "generator lost a detail the case file states" rest on that check, and I found all 8 quotes present in the archived case files so the data holds while the guard does not.

non-blocking: the only check that the regenerated records came from the archived case files sits behind `if ARCHIVED_CASE_FILES.is_dir()`, so an absent archive turns it into a silent no-op and --check still prints OK on records with no verified provenance — the case this run's own first attempt hit when a run directory had been deleted at release.
